what_this_is: The questions whose judge picks are held for writer tests. build_judge_picks.py runs search and the judge ONCE for each and saves the result in judge_picks.json; every writer test then starts from those saved picks. To add a question, add a line here with a new id and run build_judge_picks.py again - only questions not yet held are run.

sources.live 2026-11-23: Questions asked of the running service on 2026-11-23, on the current models.
sources.WP-D13b trial: The fifteen questions of the WP-D13b headline trial (also used for the Fix 1 and Fix 6 live runs).
sources.D5.1 set: From experiments/questions.json, the WP-D5 question set: twelve of its 34 place questions (six Gram Panchayats, three blocks, three districts) and every measure, vague and open question not already in the trial fifteen.
sources.WP-D15 two places: Three questions that name two places (two blocks through ruling R4, two Gram Panchayats, two districts), added for the WP-D15 trial's two-place answers.
